dedupe_keys.name: project returns for identification and characterization of abandoned padded wellsites using remote sensing

description: The project maps abandoned padded wellsites in peatlands within Alberta Boreal and Foothills regions. It combines LiDAR and Sentinel-2 observations in a supervised classifier. The source reports 7,077 padded sites and 8,006 unpadded sites, with the returned dataset containing the padded-site locations. It reports class accuracies of 81.2% for no pad and 73.9% for pad, and 78% overall. These are source-reported results, not independently validated scores. Pads were constructed during 1940–2020. Only HTML/XML descriptive metadata links are listed, so the actual GIS encoding and access route remain unresolved. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
